facts.text: The Wisconsin Tuition Promise covers up to four years of tuition and segregated fees at UW-Whitewater for state residents with family incomes of $55,000 or lower.

sources.title: Grants - UW-Whitewater
sources.quote: The 2025 Wisconsin Tuition Promise can provide up to four years of tuition and segregated fees (less book rental) funding for students from families with a $55,000 or lower adjusted gross income (AGI).
